scope: Existing transferred payload bytes and immutable Git objects only; no source application, preparation, build, compiler, or test execution.
applyRule: Require each destination's SHA256 to equal this row's beforeSHA256 before replacing it with the existing payload file. A newer base requires this same per-file precondition; do not overwrite unrelated source edits.

canonicalPayloadBinding.algorithm: SHA256 over UTF-8 JSON of rows in ledger order with keys sorted, separators comma/colon, and fields path,beforeSHA256,afterSHA256,afterBytes,payloadRelativePath

modeBoundary: Do not infer original preparation mode provenance from payload permissions alone; before/after SHA verification proves contents. Any chmod materialization needs original capture authority.

inspectorCorrection.initialAssumption: Every tracked ledger row changes content bytes.
inspectorCorrection.observedException: css-tree/lib/data.js is byte-identical and has an observed transferred permission difference (Git100644; payload0755).
inspectorCorrection.status: Corrected evidence classifier; not a production, compiler, build, or test failure.
